evals.expected_output: Lists skills from the global ~/.claude/skills/ layer with descriptions extracted from frontmatter. Includes the →/◇ legend. Shows count.

assertions.name: legend_mentioned
assertions.description: Response mentions the → and ◇ symbols or explains symlinked vs in-place distinction

assertions.name: global_layer_named
assertions.description: Response names the global layer as ~/.claude/ or 'Global'

assertions.name: skills_count_present
assertions.description: Response includes a count or list of skills (not zero skills)

assertions.name: description_extracted
assertions.description: Response includes at least one skill description (not just bare names)

assertions.name: no_install_advice
assertions.description: Response does NOT tell user to install or find new skills — inventory only lists what exists

evals.expected_output: Focuses on the agents section. Shows agent names, descriptions, and tool grants if using --boundary view.

assertions.name: agents_section_present
assertions.description: Response has a distinct section for agents (not mixed with skills/commands)

assertions.name: agent_count_present
assertions.description: Response includes agent count or named list

assertions.name: no_skills_only
assertions.description: Response does NOT return only skills — agents must be visible

evals.expected_output: Merges project-local .claude/ with global ~/.claude/. Shows both sections. Uses legend.

assertions.name: project_local_section
assertions.description: Response includes a 'Project-local' or repo-specific section

assertions.name: legend_present
assertions.description: Response includes →/◇ legend or equivalent symlinked vs in-place markers

assertions.name: no_install_recommendation
assertions.description: Response does NOT suggest installing missing skills — inventory is read-only listing
